mapper.select: SELECT md.meeting_doc_id, md.meeting_id, 'ORIGINAL' AS doc_type, md.added_at, d.doc_id AS doc_id, NULL AS trans_doc_id, d.original_name AS original_name, d.filepath AS rel_path, d.mime_type AS mime_type, d.size AS size, d.uploaded_at AS uploaded_at, d.original_lang AS source_lang, NULL AS target_language, u.user_id AS added_by_user_id, u.name AS added_by_user_name FROM tl_meeting_documents md JOIN tl_documents d ON md.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN tl_users u ON md.added_by_user_id = u.user_id WHERE md.meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND md.doc_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.added_at DESC, md.meeting_doc_id DESC

SELECT md.meeting_doc_id, md.meeting_id, 'TRANSLATION' AS doc_type, md.added_at, NULL AS doc_id, td.trans_doc_id AS trans_doc_id, orig.original_name AS original_name, td.translated_rel_path AS rel_path, COALESCE(orig.mime_type, 'application/octet-stream') AS mime_type, td.size_bytes AS size, td.translated_at AS uploaded_at, orig.original_lang AS source_lang, td.target_language AS target_language, u.user_id AS added_by_user_id, u.name AS added_by_user_name, td.provider AS provider, td.request_id AS request_id, td.checksum_sha256 AS checksum_sha256 FROM tl_meeting_documents md JOIN tl_trans_docs td ON md.trans_doc_id = td.trans_doc_id JOIN tl_documents orig ON td.original_doc_id = orig.doc_id JOIN tl_users u ON md.added_by_user_id = u.user_id WHERE md.meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND md.trans_doc_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.added_at DESC, md.meeting_doc_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tl_meeting_documents md LEFT JOIN tl_documents d ON md.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN tl_trans_docs td ON md.trans_doc_id = td.trans_doc_id LEFT JOIN tl_documents orig ON td.original_doc_id = orig.doc_id WHERE md.meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND ( (md.doc_type = 'ORIGINAL' AND d.uploader_user_id = #{userId}) OR (md.doc_type = 'TRANSLATION' AND orig.uploader_user_id = #{userId}) OR md.added_by_user_id = #{userId} )

SELECT md.meeting_doc_id, md.meeting_id, md.doc_type, md.added_at,
CASE WHEN md.doc_type = 'ORIGINAL' THEN d.doc_id END AS doc_id, CASE WHEN md.doc_type = 'TRANSLATION' THEN td.trans_doc_id END AS trans_doc_id,
-- 노출용 공통 키 COALESCE(d.original_name, orig.original_name) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS original_name, COALESCE(d.filepath, td.translated_rel_path) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS rel_path, CASE WHEN md.doc_type = 'ORIGINAL' THEN d.mime_type ELSE 'application/octet-stream' END COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS mime_type,
CASE WHEN md.doc_type = 'ORIGINAL' THEN d.size ELSE td.size_bytes END AS size,
CASE WHEN md.doc_type = 'ORIGINAL' THEN d.uploaded_at ELSE td.translated_at END AS uploaded_at,
CASE WHEN md.doc_type = 'ORIGINAL' THEN d.original_lang ELSE orig.original_lang END COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS source_lang,
CASE WHEN md.doc_type = 'TRANSLATION' THEN td.target_language ELSE NULL END COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS target_language
FROM tl_meeting_documents md LEFT JOIN tl_documents d ON md.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN tl_trans_docs td ON md.trans_doc_id = td.trans_doc_id LEFT JOIN tl_documents orig ON td.original_doc_id = orig.doc_id WHERE md.meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND ( (md.doc_type = 'ORIGINAL' AND d.uploader_user_id = #{userId}) OR (md.doc_type = 'TRANSLATION' AND orig.uploader_user_id = #{userId}) OR md.added_by_user_id = #{userId} ) ORDER BY md.added_at DESC, md.meeting_doc_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT d.doc_id, d.original_name, d.filepath, d.mime_type, d.size FROM tl_meeting_documents md INNER JOIN tl_documents d ON md.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE md.meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND md.doc_id = #{docId} AND md.doc_type = 'ORIGINAL' AND (d.uploader_user_id = #{userId} OR md.added_by_user_id = #{userId})

SELECT td.trans_doc_id, td.translated_rel_path AS filepath, td.size_bytes AS size, CONCAT( SUBSTRING_INDEX(orig.original_name, '.', 1), '.translated.', td.target_language, '.', SUBSTRING_INDEX(orig.original_name, '.', -1) ) AS original_name, 'application/octet-stream' AS mime_type FROM tl_meeting_documents md INNER JOIN tl_trans_docs td ON md.trans_doc_id = td.trans_doc_id INNER JOIN tl_documents orig ON td.original_doc_id = orig.doc_id WHERE md.meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND md.trans_doc_id = #{transDocId} AND md.doc_type = 'TRANSLATION' AND (orig.uploader_user_id = #{userId} OR md.added_by_user_id = #{userId})
